clue.text: Most of money's given to the Italian writer

indicators.note: most of a word means all but its final letter is kept here

parts.note: pence are British money, small coins
il is the Italian word for 'the'

explanation.surface: Someone hands most of their cash to an Italian author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Most of' drops the last letter of PENCE, leaving PENC; 'given to' just joins it to IL.
explanation.definitionFit: A writing implement made of graphite in wood is something that writes, hence a writer.

clue.text: Celebrate once chance comes up

parts.note: ex means former, once

indicators.note: in a down entry, coming up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: lot means fate or chance

explanation.surface: A celebration happens once luck finally arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes up' turns LOT into TOL in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To praise highly or laud is to celebrate someone.

clue.text: Beat artist?

parts.note: read as a musician who plays to a beat, it is really a police officer who walks a beat, and also the English landscape painter of that surname

explanation.surface: A musician who specialises in rhythm.
explanation.walkthrough: A British police constable patrols a 'beat'; John Constable painted The Hay Wain.
explanation.definitionFit: A police officer on foot patrols a beat, and the painter shares the name, so both senses meet.

clue.text: Take off without proper IT equipment

indicators.note: without here means outside, so one word surrounds another

parts.note: to lop is to cut off or take off
apt means fitting or proper

explanation.surface: Removing something leaves you without the right computer kit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of 'outside', not 'lacking', which is what makes the surface read naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: A portable computer is a piece of information-technology hardware.

clue.text: Pure, top grade herb used in cooking

parts.note: angelic means innocent, pure
A is the top grade in exams

explanation.surface: A pure, first-class herb for the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: Angelica is an aromatic plant whose candied stems are used in baking and confectionery.

clue.text: Fancy a Pole smiling at Emma it's sex appeal

parts.note: N is the north pole

indicators.note: fancy as an adjective means elaborate or fanciful, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether you fancy a Polish man grinning at Emma, saying it's sex appeal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fancy' looks like the verb 'desire' but signals the anagram of A, N and SMILINGATEMMA.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal magnetism is a phrase for raw physical charisma or attractiveness.

clue.text: Have time now to make it

parts.note: to get is to have or obtain
here can mean now, at this point

explanation.surface: Advice that you have time now to succeed.
explanation.definitionFit: To make it is to arrive or succeed, reaching the goal.

clue.text: Not the first one to go down river

parts.note: to go down is to lose, be defeated

explanation.surface: A remark that the first person to sink was not first into the river.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who does not come first in a contest is a defeated competitor.

clue.text: Friendly link — one's joined with supporter

definitions.note: used adverbially, in a friendly way

parts.note: a cord is a connecting string or link
one is I, the Roman numeral; the 's is merely possessive
an ally is a supporter

explanation.surface: A friendly connection is formed when one joins a supporter.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition must be read as an adverb: done in a friendly manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting warmly and sincerely is behaving in an amiable, heartfelt way.

clue.text: Obtain direct opinion

parts.note: to obtain in its formal sense is to be in force, to stand
to point is to direct

explanation.surface: Get a straight answer when asking for a view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Obtain' looks like 'get' but is the rarer sense 'prevail': a rule that obtains still stands.
explanation.definitionFit: A viewpoint or position on an issue is an opinion.

clue.text: Angry men in Kent

indicators.note: in places one word within another here

parts.note: Kent is a county in the south-east of England, SE
OR, other ranks, are ordinary soldiers, men

explanation.surface: Furious men living in the English county of Kent.
explanation.walkthrough: Kent is a county in south-east England, so it gives SE.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling aggrieved or annoyed is being cross, chiefly in American use.

clue.text: To help out soldiers proves too much

indicators.note: out signals that the letters are put out of order

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, soldiers

explanation.surface: Sending in troops to assist turns out to be excessive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' reads as part of the phrase 'help out' in the surface, but it is the anagram signal for TO HELP, giving PLETHO.
explanation.definitionFit: An excess or surplus of something is more than is needed.

clue.text: Reportedly leading lady's horse

indicators.note: reportedly signals the word is as heard, a sound-alike

parts.note: a heroine is the female lead of a story

explanation.surface: The star actress, so rumour has it, owns a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horse' is drug slang for the narcotic.
explanation.definitionFit: Horse is slang for the opiate drug derived from morphine.

clue.text: Painful strike could make you tense in advance

indicators.note: in puts one letter inside another word here

parts.note: a sub is an advance on wages
T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: A painful blow could leave you tense ahead of time.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'sub' is a British term for an advance payment of wages.
explanation.definitionFit: To strike a toe painfully against something is to knock it, the classic toe injury.

clue.text: Ruth uses a different reference book

indicators.note: different means the letters are made different, rearranged

explanation.surface: Ruth consults another reference book.
explanation.definitionFit: A book of synonyms is a reference work.

clue.text: Mark about to fix worn out plant

parts.note: a can mean about or around, as in a-hunting
to rig is to fix dishonestly
old means worn out

explanation.surface: Mark is about to repair a worn-out plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The marigold is a flowering plant with orange or yellow blooms.

clue.text: Number dashing around to get out and about

indicators.note: around shows one word is placed round another

parts.note: gallant means dashing, brave and stylish
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A stylish number rushing around town.
explanation.definitionFit: To gad about seeking pleasure is to roam around socially.

clue.text: Premier police officer's out of the country

parts.note: DI is a detective inspector

indicators.note: out shows the letters of the country are disordered

parts.note: Israel is a country

explanation.surface: The prime minister's police officer is abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges ISRAEL into SRAELI; the 's is just 'is'. A DI is a British detective inspector.
explanation.definitionFit: Benjamin Disraeli was a nineteenth-century British prime minister.

clue.text: Going back earlier after losing power

indicators.note: losing means a letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: preceding means coming earlier

explanation.surface: Retreating to an earlier time after a loss of power.
explanation.definitionFit: To recede is to retreat or withdraw.

clue.text: Told of lounge covers

indicators.note: told of signals the word as it is spoken

parts.note: to laze is to lounge

explanation.surface: Stories were related about a sofa's covers.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay a surface is to spread something over it, as with carpet or a cloth.

clue.text: Perfect texture

definitions.meaning: to perfect something is to complete it, put the last touch on it
the surface quality of wood or paint is its final coat or texture

explanation.definitionFit: Polishing off work completes it, and a polished surface is its final coat.

clue.text: Thing of substance

definitions.meaning: a thing as in an affair or issue

explanation.definitionFit: An affair or subject is a concern, and physical material is the stuff of the universe.

clue.text: Chinese style article of clothing?

parts.note: Tang is a Chinese dynasty, giving its name to a style
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An item of dress in Chinese fashion.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits that a tiny bikini bottom is barely clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A very skimpy pair of briefs is minimal swimwear.

clue.text: Single lie about student into crack

indicators.note: about signals the letters are turned around and rearranged
into places one letter inside a word

parts.note: a crack can be a jibe, a gibe
L is a learner, a student

explanation.surface: A single person's lie about a student getting into a scrape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges LIE as ELI; L goes into GIBE.
explanation.definitionFit: An unmarried person is an available bachelor, a suitable match.

clue.text: City to laze around for example?

indicators.note: around shows one word wraps another

parts.note: to lie about is to laze
eg means for example

explanation.surface: A city where you can laze about, for example.
explanation.definitionFit: Liège is a city in Belgium.

clue.text: Resolve to press on

definitions.meaning: firmness of purpose, a will of steel
to smooth clothes with a hot appliance

explanation.surface: A determination to keep going.
explanation.definitionFit: Steely determination is an iron will, and pressing laundry is ironing it.

clue.text: Dateline I'm changing, to be taken out

indicators.note: changing signals the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone altering the dateline is removed.
explanation.definitionFit: Removed or killed off is got rid of.

clue.text: Not really a way out?

parts.note: a fantasy escape from reality that is not a real exit

explanation.surface: A doubt about whether an exit is genuine.
explanation.definitionFit: Retreat into fantasy offers mental relief rather than actual escape.

clue.text: Tropical breeding ground?

parts.note: a warm place where something breeds, read like a patch of jungle

explanation.surface: A breeding site in the tropics.
explanation.definitionFit: A place that fosters rapid growth, of crime or ideas, is like a warm frame for seedlings.
